metadata.Name: MTNT
metadata.Description: A dataset for machine translation of noisy text, containing comments from Reddit.
metadata.Paper Title: MTNT: A Testbed for Machine Translation of Noisy Text
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
metadata.Abstract: This paper introduces MTNT, a new dataset for testing the robustness of machine translation systems to noisy text. The dataset contains naturally created noisy source sentences with professionally sourced translations in English, French, and Japanese. The paper describes the collection procedure, dataset analysis, and baseline experiments for machine translation and language modeling tasks.
